description: This strategy identifies mean reversion opportunities when price breaches Bollinger Bands (2 std dev) and RSI (14 period) simultaneously indicates extreme overbought (>70) or oversold (<30) conditions. It aims to capture reversals from these overextended moves, representing a confluence of volatility and momentum signals.
entry_logic: LONG: Close < BB_Lower(20,2) AND RSI(14) < 30 AND Close is within 1% of BB_Lower(20,2). SHORT: Close > BB_Upper(20,2) AND RSI(14) > 70 AND Close is within 1% of BB_Upper(20,2).
